```yaml
name: PR Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]

jobs:
  preview:
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install mkdocs mike

      - name: Get changed docs URLs
        id: changed_urls
        run: |
          echo "urls=$(python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build docs
        run: mkdocs build

      - name: Deploy preview
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          mike deploy --push --no-commit --no-browser --version pr/${{ github.event.number }} --message "PR preview" --force

      - name: Post preview comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.number }}
          body: |
            :rocket: PR preview available at https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.number }}/
            ${{ steps.changed_urls.outputs.urls }}
          edit-mode: replace
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  cleanup:
    if: github.event.action == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install mike
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mike

      - name: Delete preview
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          mike delete --push pr/${{ github.event.number }}
```
